subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: May an experimental Claw install or reuse a process-wide plugin, and if so what explicit host-level authorization must bind that shared-runtime mutation?
rationale: The code can implement either per-agent isolation or a shared-host grant, but selecting the permanent authorization boundary changes the security and ownership contract for every Claw user.

options.title: Require an explicit shared-host grant
options.body: Keep plugin support only when the consented plan includes a distinct host-level grant for the shared plugin mutation and prove that boundary on the current head.

options.title: Defer process-wide plugins
options.body: Allow only workspace-scoped skill packages in this lifecycle slice until plugins have an approved per-agent or shared-resource contract.

options.title: Adopt a per-agent plugin model
options.body: Design a plugin isolation boundary so a Claw cannot change the runtime available to sibling agents.

recommendation.title: Require an explicit shared-host grant
recommendation.body: Keep plugin support only when the consented plan includes a distinct host-level grant for the shared plugin mutation and prove that boundary on the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded review identifies the precise shared-runtime security and ownership decision that must be made.
